purpose: Candidate retrieval keys; only source-verified lessons, not claims of successful agent adaptation.

lessons.name: Do not substitute a proxy milestone for the user's end objective
lessons.operational_rule: Identify actual target environment, omitted realism, and an explicit prototype exit gate before more optimization. Label proxy metrics honestly.
lessons.exceptions: Use a prototype as final deliverable only if user explicitly selected that scope.

lessons.name: Keep evidence and competence claims at the same verification tier
lessons.operational_rule: Separate infrastructure, offline imitation, native gameplay, independent replay, genuinely rendered footage, visual inspection, and matched performance. Promote no unsupported claim.
lessons.exceptions: Describe observed source-only or offline facts as such; these remain valid engineering findings.

lessons.name: Automate actual-world recording and verification when feasible
lessons.operational_rule: Execute genuine environment, capture full action/state logs and rendered evidence, check media integrity and inspect real frames. Distinguish an input replay from a video.
lessons.exceptions: Do not claim visual verification when native renderer or image observations are unavailable; request only genuinely inaccessible resources.

lessons.name: Do not confuse isolated execution runtimes
lessons.operational_rule: Check the actual execution environment and durable artifact paths. Restore hashed sources, bound retries, fail closed on missing pinned prerequisites, and do not trigger a disallowed fallback.
lessons.exceptions: If user explicitly authorizes hosted execution, respect their compute, security, cost, and scheduling constraints.

lessons.name: Verify live state before using historical memory
lessons.operational_rule: Read current designated source-of-truth and evidence first. A correction requires checking contradicted claims; lack of local access does not prove absence of work elsewhere.
lessons.exceptions: If live authority cannot be accessed, label facts unknown or user-reported instead of asserting no work was done.

lessons.name: Use matched baselines and rule out confounding mechanisms
lessons.operational_rule: Measure the target behavior on identical conditions, preserve checkpoint provenance, separate external resource effects and avoid selection on sealed final seeds.
lessons.exceptions: A preliminary noncausal diagnostic may still be useful if labeled descriptive and followed by a comparative test.

lessons.name: Treat repeated corrections as experience, not prompt inflation
lessons.operational_rule: Record original belief, observed action, user-intent delta, counterfactual, transferable trigger, exception and an independent test. Keep original evidence and de-duplicate rules.
lessons.exceptions: Do not store routine or sensitive content unnecessarily or claim corrected behavior without a future independent task trial.

lessons.name: Do feasible work autonomously, escalate genuine authority boundaries
lessons.operational_rule: Execute bounded reversible tasks when source and tools exist; stop and ask for authorization or missing private access rather than inventing results or seeking human work unnecessarily.
lessons.exceptions: Never infer that being proactive overrides paid compute, private credentials, destructive operations or sealed research controls.
